mapper.update: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_entity ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), kb_id uuid NOT NULL, name text NOT NULL, type varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TERM', created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT uk_knowledge_entity_kb_name UNIQUE (kb_id, name) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunk_entity_mention ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), kb_id uuid NOT NULL, doc_id uuid NOT NULL, chunk_id uuid NOT NULL, entity_id uuid NOT NULL, entity_name text NOT NULL, created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT uk_chunk_entity_mention UNIQUE (kb_id, chunk_id, entity_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entity_relation ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), kb_id uuid NOT NULL, source_entity_id uuid NOT NULL, target_entity_id uuid NOT NULL, relation_type varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CO_OCCURS_WITH', source_chunk_id uuid NOT NULL, doc_id uuid NOT NULL, weight integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT uk_entity_relation_chunk UNIQUE (kb_id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relation_type, source_chunk_id) )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_entity_kb_name ON knowledge_entity (kb_id, name)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunk_entity_mention_kb_chunk ON chunk_entity_mention (kb_id, chunk_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_entity_relation_kb_source ON entity_relation (kb_id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, name, type, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_entity WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_entity (kb_id, name, type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), #{name}, #{type}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO chunk_entity_mention (kb_id, doc_id, chunk_id, entity_id, entity_name, created_at) VALUES ( CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{docId} AS uuid), CAST(#{chunkId} AS uuid), CAST(#{entityId} AS uuid), #{entityName}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, chunk_id, entity_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO entity_relation ( kb_id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relation_type, source_chunk_id, doc_id, weight, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{sourceEntityId} AS uuid), CAST(#{targetEntityId} AS uuid), #{relationType}, CAST(#{sourceChunkId} AS uuid), CAST(#{docId} AS uuid), COALESCE(#{weight}, 1), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relation_type, source_chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET weight = entity_relation.weight + 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM entity_relation WHERE doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid)
DELETE FROM chunk_entity_mention WHERE doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid)
